title: Scalar comparison respects lower-singleton maps
statement: For an essentially small site C, inverse ring-sheaf sequences B,D, natural ring map a : B → D, normalized scalar models S with coherence T and sequence scalar model A, use the fixed singleton/scalar constructions [def-pur-system-singleton-scalar-comparisons]. For n ≤ m and every unbounded derived B_m-object P, scalar extension of the lower-singleton map followed by d_m equals d_n on the derived transition tensor of P, followed by the D_n-singleton applied to the specified scalar associator square, and then the D lower-singleton map. This is the equality of actual derived morphisms, not only evaluated cohomology maps.

source.place: Parent Step 9: Zheng Construction 4.1, printed p. 21; Stacks 0D6D and 06YT.

proof.text: Choose a flat-term K-flat B_m-resolution Q. Every scalar extension in the square is flat-term K-flat by ringed-topos pullback. Below n, the lower-singleton representative is the associator b tensor (t tensor q) ↦ b rho_jn(t) tensor q; above n its source is zero. Normalized singleton transposition identifies these representative maps with singletonLowerMap.

At j ≤ n the scalar comparison formula sends (b tensor q) tensor c to a_j(b)c tensor (q tensor 1). The two lower-singleton routes thus send (b tensor (t tensor q)) tensor c to a_j(b rho_jn(t))c tensor (q tensor 1) and a_j(b)c rho_jn(a_n(t)) tensor (q tensor 1). They agree by naturality of a. Balancing, sheafification and compatibility with signed differentials give equality of the actual cochain maps. Above n both maps vanish; n=m gives multiplication. The representative equality and normalized scalar associators identify these maps with the specified derived square. Localize and transport through the resolution isomorphism; naturality gives the square at every P.

theorem singletonScalarDerivedIso_lower (n m : ℕ) (h : n ≤ m)
    (P : DerivedCategory (systemLevel B m)) :
      A.model.T.map (singletonLowerMap S T B h P) ≫
          (singletonScalarDerivedIso S T a A m).hom.app P =
        (singletonScalarDerivedIso S T a A n).hom.app ((systemDerivedTensor S B h).obj P) ≫
          (singletonSequenceDerived S T D n).map ((singletonScalarSquare S a n m h).hom.app P) ≫
          singletonLowerMap S T D h ((S (a.app (op m))).model.T.obj P)
